tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind the wizard and dashboard.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Rule cards, audit tables, the account panel.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Dot-grid and chart gridlines. Decorative only; never carries meaning.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Panel borders and table rules. A decorative hairline (below 3:1); controls use control-border.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of buttons, inputs and radios: 3:1 or better on panel and ground in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, rule logic and numbers, on ground and panel.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Field labels, units, timestamps and event metadata, on ground and panel.

tokens.name: ledger
tokens.usage: Brand and primary action: Generate, Approve, Run simulation. As text, on ground, panel or ledger-soft. Also the APPROVED state.

tokens.name: on-ledger
tokens.usage: Label on a ledger fill (primary button, APPROVED pill).

tokens.name: ledger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind an approved rule card header or selected wizard step.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: Highlighter fill for editable demo assumptions and the SYNTHETIC / DEMO-ONLY labels. Text on it is always ink-on-marker.

tokens.name: ink-on-marker
tokens.usage: Text on a marker fill in both themes.

tokens.name: marker-ink
tokens.usage: DRAFT state and assumption text, on ground, panel or marker-soft.

tokens.name: marker-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a DRAFT card, a clarification question or an assumption row.

tokens.name: compliant
tokens.usage: Compliant decisions and CONNECTED status. Blue, so it is never told apart from blocked by red/green hue alone. Text on ground, panel or compliant-soft.

tokens.name: compliant-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a compliant audit row or chip.

tokens.name: blocked
tokens.usage: BLOCK_ENTRY, risk lock, violations and errors. Always paired with a word. Text on ground, panel or blocked-soft.

tokens.name: blocked-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the risk-lock panel or a blocked audit row.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1 or better on ground, panel and every soft tint.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the wizard's opening line or the report headline.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card headings and table section labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Two consecutive losing positions lock new entries until the next session.
styles.usage: Explanations, scenario narratives and help text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field labels and pill text.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Headline numbers: equity, conformance. Always tabular.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: IF/THEN rule lines, field names, rule_id and event values.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a value and its unit, pill padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a field, between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, rule line spacing.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between wizard sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Pills, chips, the marker label.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, audit rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels. Nothing is rounder.
